item.title: QOTD
item.description:
“It’s not enough to fly first class, others must fly coach.”

If you’ve flown first class, can you share the experience? I only know Ryanair… at least there is no first class in those planes!

item.title: QOTD
item.description:
“Privilege is invisible to those who have it.”

Can we get a little bit more empathy around here?

item.title: QOTD
item.description:
“Every man has two deaths, when he is buried in the ground and the last time someone says his name.”

Why can’t we invert the order? Let’s get forgotten before perishing organically!
